Definition: Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Baal-hanan = "Baal is gracious"; 1) an early king of Edom; 2) one of David's officers, a Gederite, who had the superintendence of his olive and sycamore plantations
